meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Whispered Sequence
quests.narrative_guidance: Archivist Tol Varin needs a specific frequency to complete a sentence from the storm, but it requires drone-level processing and a religious blessing.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the encrypted plasma-crystal from Archivist Tol Varin.
Take the crystal to Unit-77 to process the binary storm-whispers.
Deliver the processed data to High Priest Orun for a final ritual blessing to unlock the message.

quests.title: Storm-Diver's Toll
quests.narrative_guidance: Seraphine Kael is trying to smuggle critical components through the Ion, but Captain Drevos's drones are blocking the route and Dakar Vey needs to hack the security.
improvisation_points: Obtain the smuggling manifest from Seraphine Kael.
Convince or bribe Captain Drevos to lower the orbital drone perimeter.
Escort the manifest to Dakar Vey to finalize the encrypted flight path.

quests.title: Ghost in the Machine
quests.narrative_guidance: Mira Vox hears her mother's voice coming from the defense grid. She needs Sergeant Vax's clearance and Scout Nyx's tracking data to find the source.
improvisation_points: Listen to Mira Vox's glowing tears to identify the frequency.
Request the defense grid logs from Sergeant Vax.
Follow Scout Nyx to the remote location where the signal is strongest.

quests.title: Foundry Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Master Smith Borin suspects a flaw in the Ion-blades. He needs Welder Tali to inspect the welds and Foreman Grog to investigate the labor source.
improvisation_points: Accept a prototype blade from Master Smith Borin.
Bring the blade to Welder Tali for a structural analysis.
Present the findings to Foreman Grog to identify the saboteur in the ribs.

quests.title: The Kinetic Circuit
quests.narrative_guidance: Duelist Kaelen needs the treasury to fund a tournament, but the volts are missing and the scrappers are the primary suspects.
improvisation_points: Receive the tournament request from Duelist Kaelen.
Verify the missing power logs with Treasurer Sola.
Recover the stolen energy cells from Scrapper Pip in the ghetto.

quests.title: The Gear-Grasp Gamble
quests.narrative_guidance: Mechanist Fix believes a gear is sentient. He needs Overseer Ryn to stop the line so Bard Lute can record its 'voice'.
improvisation_points: Acquire the special listening device from Mechanist Fix.
Persuade Overseer Ryn to temporarily halt Flux-Line Row.
Deliver the gear's recordings to Bard Lute for interpretation.

quests.title: The Slag's Secret
quests.narrative_guidance: Wastelander Crev found a strange artifact in the slag, but it needs the heat of the kilns and the soil of the fields to activate.
improvisation_points: Acquire the glowing slag artifact from Wastelander Crev.
Place the artifact in the Cobalt Kilns with Stoker Ignis to heat it up.
Bury the heated artifact in the Thunder-Thresher Fields for Farmer Jax to observe the reaction.

quests.title: The High-Velocity Smuggle
quests.narrative_guidance: Guide a high-priority smuggler convoy safely through the upper storm currents into the grounding pits.
improvisation_points: Obtain the storm-eye navigation charts from Seraphine Kael.
Secure a high-speed gantry bypass from Rigger Zephyr to avoid Hegemony patrols.
Deliver the cargo to Scavenger Rust in the Copper Sump for final grounding.

quests.title: The Sentence of Plasma
quests.narrative_guidance: Help decode a vital message from the storm whispers that could unlock the Hegemony's main reactor.
improvisation_points: Collect the initial whisper fragment from Archivist Tol Varin.
Use Runner Spark's speed to deliver the fragment to the relay station before the signal decays.
Have Scribe Mute record the final translated sentence into the Whisper Archive.

quests.title: Orbital Blackout
quests.narrative_guidance: Sabotage the drone network to allow a rebel signal to reach the outer colonies.
improvisation_points: Extract the drone patrol routes from Captain Drevos under the guise of an inspection.
Retrieve the necessary EMP components from Harvester Bolt's stash in the Basin.
Activate the signal jammer within Shielder Cage's Faraday zone.

quests.title: The Mother's Frequency
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort Mira Vox to the deepest vaults so she can hear the voice of the Ion Throne.
improvisation_points: Protect Mira Vox during her ritual at the Tuning Chamber.
Coordinate with Slider Dash to find a path through the Friction Flats that avoids static interference.
Reach the Lead-Lined Corridors where Tunnel-Rat Scurry will hide Mira from the Harmonizer's ears.

quests.title: Rogue Protocol Uplink
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist Unit-77 in reclaiming a lost memory core hidden within the city's power grid.
improvisation_points: Receive the encrypted core location from Unit-77.
Manipulate the coil rotation with Spinner Coil to generate the specific frequency needed to reveal the core.
Upload the core data into the Grounding Grids under the supervision of Tech Static.

quests.title: The Master Encryption Key
quests.narrative_guidance: Extract an Overseer command code from the whispers to bypass Hegemony security.
improvisation_points: Receive the decryption software from Dakar Vey.
Infiltrate the Surge Gate and use Warden Gate's console to run the extraction.
Cool the overheating data crystal at Refiner Gloam's insulator works to preserve the key.

quests.title: The Great Convergence Ritual
quests.narrative_guidance: Join a ritual to 'merge' with the storm and achieve absolute synchronization.
improvisation_points: Acquire the lightning-charged focus from High Priest Orun.
Trade for the rare kinetic catalysts at Trader Flicker's Arc-Light Market.
Perform the final resonance at the Sub-Signal Vaults with Deep-Ear Echo to ground the divine signal.

quests.title: The Whispered Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover a lost frequency key from the Scribes' Walkway to facilitate a trade in the Frequency Markets.
improvisation_points: Obtain the tuning fork calibration from Elara Sync.
Take the calibration to Malos Vox to locate the key's signature.
Deliver the decrypted key to Kaelen Bit for payment.

quests.title: Static Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Divert excess power from the Capacitor Fields to the Smelters to prevent a cascade failure.
improvisation_points: Collect the discharge codes from Oris Volt.
Input the codes at the Terrace terminal guarded by Leda Ozone.
Confirm the power transfer with Grak Smelter at the forges.

quests.title: Ghost in the Antenna
quests.narrative_guidance: Carry an ancestral signal from the Hall of Waves to the Oracular Crypts to awaken a sleeping prophecy.
improvisation_points: Receive the sonic urn from Thal Waves.
Have Kiri Perch align the signal with the Spire's peak.
Deposit the urn in the Oracular Crypts with Vahn Crypt.

quests.title: Dormitory Disturbance
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate a rogue transmission that is disrupting sleep in the dorms and trace it to the docks.
improvisation_points: Receive a recording of the disturbance from Sora Echo.
Track the signal source through the Archive of Static with Juro Static.
Identify the illegal transmitter at the Aether-Docks with Vexen Tide.

quests.title: The Arc-Welder's Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort a shipment of specialized Guard-Coils through the dangerous Turbulence Plaza to the Welders.
improvisation_points: Secure the shipment from Harlen Coil.
Pass through the Turbulence Plaza checkpoints managed by Mira Turbulence.
Deliver the coils to Boros Arc to repair the city's shielding.

quests.title: Resonance Restoration
quests.narrative_guidance: Cultivate resonance seeds, weave them into protective shrouds, and deliver them to the clinics.
improvisation_points: Gather resonance seeds from Lyra Garden.
Deliver the seeds to Phex Shroud to be woven into fabric.
Bring the completed shrouds to Miri Null for the patients.

quests.title: Observatory Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Relay an urgent deep-space signal from the Observatory, through the Static Sinks, to the Gilded Antenna.
improvisation_points: Acquire the emergency transmission from Rina Signal.
Bypass the interference in the Static Sinks with help from Silt Static.
Broadcast the signal from the Gilded Antenna via Zeph Antenna.
